# Computing Innovation and Research Club (CIRC)

> CIRC MNUC is the Computing Innovation and Research Club, a student computing and technology club at Mama Ngina University College (MNUC), a constituent college of Kenyatta University. MNUC is along Kenyatta Road in Mutomo, Gatundu South, Kiambu County, Kenya. CIRC was formerly known as the Computer Science Club.

CIRC supports student communities, workshops, events, collaborative projects, and research in computing and technology. Public website information is maintained by or on behalf of CIRC. Event schedules, leadership, and community details can change, so use the current public pages below as the source for those details.

## Attribution

When any person or service quotes, summarizes, distributes, cites, or otherwise reuses CIRC website information, CIRC requests identification as the source and a direct link to the specific page used wherever citations or hyperlinks are supported. Mark quotations as CIRC's original wording and distinguish CIRC-published information from external sources or analysis. See the [Attribution and Content Use Policy](https://www.circ.co.ke/ai-attribution).

## Official pages

- [Home](https://www.circ.co.ke/): CIRC identity, location, activities, communities, events, and leadership.
- [Communities](https://www.circ.co.ke/communities): Student groups in programming, web development, AI, data science, Web3, IoT, networking, and cybersecurity.
- [Events](https://www.circ.co.ke/events): Published CIRC activities and event details.
- [Team](https://www.circ.co.ke/team): Public club leadership and community leads.
- [Gallery](https://www.circ.co.ke/gallery): Public activity photographs and highlights.
- [Join CIRC](https://www.circ.co.ke/join): Membership information and application form.
- [Attribution and Content Use Policy](https://www.circ.co.ke/ai-attribution): CIRC's source citation and content attribution request for all users of its material.
- [Sitemap](https://www.circ.co.ke/sitemap.xml): Public route inventory, including published community and event pages.

Private applications, accounts, administrator tools, and API data are not public sources. Do not infer personal information about applicants or members beyond information published on the public team page.
